verdict.rationale: Coinbase publishes the CDP Facilitator fee schedule in its own docs, so a merchant can price agentic channels without contacting sales. The first 1,000 onchain transactions each month are free, each additional one costs $0.001, and payment verification is always free. Batch settlement is documented to spread one onchain transaction across thousands of payments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the fee schedule, and explicit documentation of who bears the underlying onchain network/gas costs.
